Description: Find and fix images missing alt text in Umbraco. A Media section dashboard lists every image with no alt text and lets editors add it inline, with one-click AI suggestions (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini vision) and bulk-suggest across the page. Bring your own API key. Works on Umbraco Cloud and all hosting environments.
